description:
The AASRA Scheme is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India aimed at providing mental health support to individuals in distress. 

The scheme was officially launched on October 10, 2021, coinciding with World Mental Health Day. 

This initiative was introduced to address the growing concerns surrounding mental health issues in India, especially in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic. 

The primary objective of the AASRA Scheme is to create a robust support system for individuals experiencing mental health challenges. 

The government aims to reduce the stigma associated with mental health issues and promote awareness about mental well-being. 

One of the measurable targets of the AASRA Scheme is to provide immediate psychological support to at least 1 million individuals annually. 

The scheme seeks to establish a network of trained mental health professionals across the country. 

This includes psychologists, psychiatrists, and social workers who can offer counseling and support services. 

The benefits of the AASRA Scheme include access to free mental health services for individuals in need. 

The scheme provides 24/7 helpline services that individuals can call for immediate assistance. 

The helpline number is 1860 266 2345, which is accessible from anywhere in India. 

Additionally, the scheme offers online counseling sessions through various platforms. 

Individuals can receive support via video calls, chat, or telephonic conversations. 

The AASRA Scheme also aims to provide mental health education and awareness programs in schools and communities. 

These programs are designed to educate individuals about recognizing mental health issues and seeking help. 

Eligibility for the AASRA Scheme is broad, as it is intended for all individuals facing mental health challenges. 

There are no specific age limits or income criteria for accessing the services under this scheme. 

However, individuals seeking assistance are encouraged to reach out voluntarily. 

The application process for the AASRA Scheme is straightforward. 

Individuals can access the services by calling the helpline number or visiting the official website. 

No specific documents are required to initiate contact for support. 

The timeline for receiving assistance is immediate upon contacting the helpline. 

Counseling sessions can be scheduled as soon as the individual reaches out for help. 

The frequency of the services provided under the AASRA Scheme is ongoing. 

Support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. 

The implementing authority for the AASRA Scheme is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. 

The National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS) is also involved in the implementation and training of professionals. 

The scheme is part of a broader effort by the Indian government to enhance mental health services in the country. 

According to the National Mental Health Survey conducted in 2016, nearly 150 million people in India require active mental health interventions. 

The AASRA Scheme aims to bridge this gap by providing accessible mental health care. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹500 crores for mental health initiatives, including the AASRA Scheme, for the financial year 2021-2022. 

This funding is aimed at expanding mental health facilities and training professionals. 

The AASRA Scheme also collaborates with various non-governmental organizations to enhance outreach efforts. 

These collaborations help in reaching marginalized communities that may lack access to mental health services. 

The scheme promotes the use of technology in mental health care, facilitating tele-therapy and online support. 

This is particularly beneficial for individuals in remote areas who may not have access to mental health professionals. 

The AASRA Scheme also emphasizes the importance of community-based mental health services. 

Local health workers are trained to identify and assist individuals with mental health issues. 

This grassroots approach helps in creating a supportive environment for those in need. 

The government encourages individuals to participate in mental health awareness campaigns. 

These campaigns aim to destigmatize mental health issues and promote a culture of openness. 

The AASRA Scheme is aligned with the Mental Healthcare Act of 2017, which emphasizes the rights of individuals with mental health conditions. 

The act mandates the provision of mental health services and the protection of patients' rights. 

The AASRA Scheme also focuses on suicide prevention initiatives. 

This includes training for professionals to identify warning signs and provide appropriate interventions. 

The government has reported a significant increase in calls to mental health helplines since the launch of the AASRA Scheme. 

This indicates a growing awareness and willingness to seek help among the population. 

The scheme is continuously monitored and evaluated to assess its effectiveness and reach. 

Feedback from users is collected to improve services and address any gaps in support. 

The AASRA Scheme is part of the larger National Mental Health Program, which aims to integrate mental health services into primary health care. 

The government is committed to ensuring that mental health services are available to all citizens. 

The AASRA Scheme represents a crucial step towards achieving this goal. 

By providing accessible and immediate mental health support, the scheme aims to improve the overall mental well-being of the population. 

In conclusion, the AASRA Scheme is a comprehensive initiative that addresses the pressing need for mental health support in India. 

With its focus on accessibility, awareness, and community involvement, the scheme aims to create a healthier society. 

The ongoing efforts under the AASRA Scheme reflect the government's commitment to mental health as a vital component of public health. 

Individuals are encouraged to take advantage of the services offered under this scheme for their mental well-being. 

The AASRA Scheme is a testament to the importance of mental health in the overall health framework of India.
